Camila / team — quick take below. I ran numbers with ops for a 12-month commitment + a 3-month pilot option. High level:

Pricing options (playbook):
- Option A (Premium isolation): Dedicated HSM per region + 7y audit logs (cold storage): One-time implementation $65k, recurring $12k/mo (HSM maintenance + audit retention). KMS seats billed as $9k/seat/month.
- Option B (Shared HSM partitions): Shared HSM w/ logical partitions: One-time $28k, recurring $7k/mo, KMS seats $5k/seat/month.
- Option C (Throughput-first): No dedicated HSM; KMS operations as managed service with per-request pricing: One-time $18k, recurring $4k/mo, per-call $0.0005. Best for high throughput, lower isolation.

Concessions / pilot discounts we can offer:
- Pilot (90 days): waive half of one-time implementation fee + 25% recurring credit for pilot months.
- If they commit 18+ months we can amortize HSM seat cost over 12 months (cap at 6 seats) and offer a 10% commit discount on recurring.

Notes for SOW:
- Billable items: evidence transfer engineering hours (estimate 40–80h depending on push vs pull), on-site/secure-handshake support (if required) billed separately.
- Retention/liability: limit liability for audit log corruption to statutory remedies; push for customer responsibility for long-tail retention requests beyond 7 years (we can store but not retain deletion responsibility).

Happy to draft the pricing table into a one-pager. Ben

--
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Subject: MedQuant — compliance add-ons proposal and evidence-delivery plan (draft)

Elena — thank you for the extra detail. Attached is a consolidated proposal (PDF) and a draft SOW with implementation milestones and cost breakdown. Summary here so procurement has a quick read:

Summary (short):
- Offer: Option B (Shared HSM partitions) recommended as baseline for POC; Option A (Dedicated HSM per region) available for production with MSRP above.
- Pricing (baseline, 12-month): One-time implementation $28,000; recurring $7,000/month; KMS seats $5,000/seat/month (two regions → 2 seats suggested). Pilot concession: we will waive 50% of the one-time implementation fee for a 90-day pilot and provide a 25% credit on recurring charges for pilot months.
- Audit logs: 7-year retention supported. Long-term cold storage will be billed at $0.015/GB-month beyond 12 months if requested.
- Evidence delivery: we propose a push model for POC — Redwood will deliver signed transfer manifests to your SFTP endpoint daily for the pilot. For production we recommend signed manifests + mutual TLS transfer; SOW includes 40h of engineering to implement and test (more if on-prem appliance required).

Attachments included: MQ_Security_Pricing_Proposal_20280117.pdf, SOW_MedQuant_initial.docx, MedQuant_SOC2_evidence_list.pdf

Next steps we propose:
1) Confirm: preferred HSM model (shared partitions vs dedicated) and evidence transfer method (push vs pull).
2) If green-lit, legal will route the draft SOW for review (I copied procurement for visibility).
3) If you want a pricing concession, confirm desired pilot start date and commit window (90d pilot + 12m commit or 90d pilot + 18m commit triggers different amortization).

I can also add an explicit amortization appendix for KMS seats if procurement prefers monthly capital-like accounting. HubSpot deal ID is DEAL-98765 if you want to reference the online proposal.

Doc links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-98765
Docusign (SOW routing to follow): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/1234567890

If you’re good with the baseline I’ll send a final PDF and SOW by tomorrow morning.

Best regards,
